# Coding standards

- **Scope:** change only what the task needs. Fix root causes, not symptoms.
- **Reuse first:** search for an existing helper, component or pattern before adding one. Delete dead code you make dead.
- **Design:** one responsibility per module; depend inward (UI → application → domain); no import cycles. Keep functions small and names precise.
- **Errors:** fail loudly at boundaries with a clear message; never swallow exceptions silently.
- **Security:** never commit or log secrets, tokens or personal data. Use managed identity or OIDC over keys. Validate all external input.
- **Comments:** only for non-obvious intent, at most two lines. No commented-out code.
- **Naming:** `PascalCase` types and components, `camelCase` TypeScript values, `snake_case` Python, `ALL_CAPS` constants.
- **Dependencies:** add one only when it removes real work; pin it; prefer the standard library.
- **Done:** the project gate in `AGENTS.md` passes locally.
